Scenery.text: A signpost whose arms have been repainted so often the letters stand out in relief.
A figurehead over the hearth, her painted eyes following the door.
A rain barrel with a dead crab floating in it.
A bollard worn into a waist by centuries of rope.
A miner's candle stub stuck to the wall with clay.
A rope ladder, half its rungs missing.
A pick, its handle long rotted, still wedged in the rock face.
A ribbon tied to a branch, faded to no colour at all.
Coins pressed into the bark of the oldest tree, green with age.
A rusted mooring ring, worn bright on one side by a rope long gone.
Pale anemones close as your shadow passes over them.

log: — Low Harrow · Town —
You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
The Market trades in materials.
You take down the notice: A map of The Saltbriar.
You buy 4 Iron Ore at the Market for 12 gold.
You buy 4 Seasoned Timber at the Market for 12 gold.
You sell 1 Seasoned Timber to the Market for 1 gold.
The smith makes you a Cutlass for 17 gold.
The smith works on it for 5 gold: it's now a Driftwood Club +1.
You buy the Cutlass from the Smithy for 24 gold.
You sell the Cutlass to the Smithy for 7 gold.
You buy 1 Ship's Biscuit at the Market for 2 gold.
You make your way to Tarred Tavern.
The Tavern has beds for 4 gold a night and a kitchen.
The fire spits salt.
You buy a Kelp Broth at the Tavern for 6 gold.
You buy a Mussel Stew at the Tavern for 8 gold.
You eat the Mussel Stew. It'll keep you going for 60 turns.
Time passes.
Time passes.
Time passes.
The fire spits salt.
